scenario: Bitwise operators and shifts per LEXP.1 — AND, OR, XOR, left-shift, right-shift, bitwise NOT.
rules_ds:
schema T scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule band:
    T t where t.v & 6 == 4
->
    log critical "band"

rule bor:
    T t where t.v | 1 == 5
->
    log critical "bor"

rule bxor:
    T t where t.v ^ 7 == 3
->
    log critical "bxor"

rule lshift:
    T t where t.v << 2 == 16
->
    log critical "lshift"

rule rshift:
    T t where t.v >> 1 == 2
->
    log critical "rshift"
